notes:
ACCESS: reached exclusively through the Claude-in-Chrome connector in a dedicated tab (no HTTP/proxy route used). robots.txt read in-tab: Shopify storefront, agent-friendly preamble, no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web disallow (only a 'do not complete checkout automatically' instruction, which does not affect read-only browsing). www.fenwick.co.uk canonicalises to fenwick.co.uk; all links recorded on that origin. TREE: taken from the rendered homepage mega-menu DOM (the 'Furniture & Outdoor'
dropdown, 49 links). Fenwick keeps ALL furniture in one top-level 'Furniture & Outdoor' department whose collection handles are mostly prefixed 'luxury-and-designer-'; five column headers act as parents: Garden & Outdoor Furniture, Living Room Furniture, Dining Room Furniture, Office Furniture, Bedroom Furniture. The separate 'Home & Tech' department was fully dumped (69 links) and contains NO furniture (Electricals, Travel, Kitchen/cooking, Dining tableware, Home Furnishings & Accessories = decor/textiles/mirrors, Lighting, Bedroom = bed linen/pillows/duvets/mattress toppers, Bathroom = towels/bathmats, Games & Stationery). The Kids department was also dumped; its Nursery > 'Furniture & Accessories' node is the only furniture outside the Furniture & Outdoor department and is included. QTY: the collection pages render a listing header

reading 'N results'; it is injected client-side (the server HTML ships the element empty), so each URL was navigated in the tab and the element polled until numeric. That rendered header is what is recorded. Cross-check: an exhaustive same-origin /collections//products.json?limit=250 pagination shows the header equals the number of currently-purchasable products, not the full catalogue (e.g. sofas header 110 vs 135 published / 110 in-stock; armchairs header 110 vs 143 published / 109 in-stock; filing cabinets 4 = 4 = 4; small patio furniture header 11 vs 55 published / 12 in-stock). Sofas and Armchairs both reading 110 is a genuine coincidence, confirmed by two separate page loads each and by the independent in-stock counts (110 / 109). Counts vary strongly per category, so no site-wide-total artefact. A deliberately bad handle (luxury-and-designer-armchairs) returns a clean 404, so no silent parent-serving; every h1 was checked against the intended node. EXCLUDED: 'Mattresses' (bedding, per ruleset); 'BBQs & Accessories'; 'Outdoor Dining' (title scan of its 250 products: outdoor tableware, drinkware, platters, placemats - not furniture); 'Outdoor Accessories' (114 products: blankets, planters, furniture covers, scatter cushions); all Featured Brands links (BoConcept, Bramblecrest, Barker and Stonehouse, Libra Interiors, Heal's), all Featured Edits (Ready to Deliver Furniture, Create a Cosy Home, Summer Dining, Countryside Charm), New In and Sale nodes. The department parent /collections/luxury-garden-and-outdoor-furniture (112 results) is kept as a grouping row only: a product_type census of its first 250 items shows it is a mixed roll-up dominated by BBQs & Accessories (127), Garden Furniture Covers (37), Garden Cushions (20) and Parasols (8), so it is not a clean furniture leaf and its two furniture children were taken instead. 'Small Patio Furniture' was verified 96% furniture by product_type (Garden Furniture Set 37, Garden Seating 16, 2 non-furniture strays).
